narrative.overview: One upload action and six compact face slots lead to a real, automatically read cube. The established daylight workbench appears for verified solving and playback.
dos: Keep the upload action visible on the first phone screen.
Accept clear six-photo input without setup forms, crop handles, review boxes, or an extra solve click.
Keep the cube and playback controls usable together.
Distinguish verified solutions from actually solved current states.
donts: Do not change the reference frame when moving the camera.
Do not mount an example cube or expose manual forms before they are relevant.
Do not force a convenient color assignment or invent unseen stickers.
Do not claim universal camera or lighting accuracy.
